item.title: Iran’s Tayebi wins Asian Games shot put gold after 52-year wait
item.description: Nagoya, IRNA – Iranian shot putter Mohammadreza Tayebi won the men’s gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan, with a throw of 20.81 meters, breaking the Games record and ending a 52-year wait for Iran in the event.

item.title: Iranian fallow deer
item.description: The population of Iranian fallow deer has nearly quadrupled due to favorable conditions at Rashkan Site in Lake Urmia National Park and the success of its breeding programs. According to local officials in West Azarbaijan Province, 22 deer currently live at the site, including five born this year. To protect the endangered species, breeding centers have also been established in other parts of Iran.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86275120/Iranian-fallow-deer
